artifact.note: Live production deployment tested directly; bundle identified as assets/index-CcIRy9rq.js. No full artifact hash computed -- see docs/RELEASE-REVIEW-RECORD.md for the frozen candidate's hashes from the prior source-level review.

decision_question: Is the live LifeTrkr app (v0.1.10, https://okhp3.github.io/kierans-lifetrkr/#/) fully functional for its stated single-user purpose, and specifically, does the Google Calendar/Tasks connection work correctly end-to-end?
acceptance_criteria: All 8 documented routes (Home, Calendar, Today, Someday, Rituals, Habits, Settings, Origin) load without console errors, blank screens, or router failures.
Visual/design-system consistency holds across pages per the app's own Moonlit Hearth design system (cards, filter/sort pills, typography).

Clicking "Connect Google Account" completes an actual Google consent flow and either succeeds (real Calendar/Tasks data becomes available) or fails with a clear, user-visible, recoverable error -- not an indefinite silent hang.
No unhandled JavaScript errors or exceptions surface during normal navigation and interaction.
The app defaults to its own documented dark "Moonlit Hearth" theme on a fresh first visit with no saved preference.

shared_model_or_source_limits: All three initial reviewers and the negotiator ran on the same model family (claude-sonnet-5) in separate contexts -- no cross-model diversity, so agreement/disagreement among them is correlated evidence, not fully independent.
All roles reviewed one evidence dossier compiled from a single browser-automation session; none independently re-ran the live browser tests or re-fetched the production bundle.

initial_reviews.summary: The dossier's core observations are well-evidenced and appropriately self-disclosed, but several causal/temporal claims in the Google-connect section (E8) overreach what was directly observed: 'indefinitely' extrapolates a ~3-4s observation, and ruling out an app-side cause as the source of the hang is not fully supported by the zero-network-request evidence.

3 of 5 acceptance criteria fail on direct evidence (visual consistency, Google connect, dark-theme default); a 4th (no JS errors) only partially clears since core CRUD/persistence flows were never exercised. The app cannot be certified fully functional for its stated purpose on this evidence.

The Google-connect failure mode is exactly what acceptance criterion 3 was written to forbid: a silent, unrecoverable hang. Source review confirms no timeout/circuit-breaker exists, making this a structural defect, not a one-off flake, regardless of root cause. Manual accessibility and OAuth-scope safety remain unverified open risks.

decisive_evidence: Clicking Connect Google Account produced an unresolved 'Connecting...' state with zero console output and zero network requests, reproduced twice from a fresh reload.
Source review (uncontested by all three reviewers): useGoogleAuth.requestToken() has no timeout -- the promise only settles from inside a GIS callback that may never fire.
Fresh page load rendered the light 'Morning Parchment' theme, not the documented dark 'Moonlit Hearth' default.
Calendar/Rituals/Habits filter-chip rows render as unstyled outlined text, confirmed via a pixel-region screenshot, versus Someday's correctly filled pills.
All 8 routes rendered cleanly with zero console messages.
unresolved_items: Root cause of the Google-connect hang: OAuth origin misconfiguration vs. FedCM/third-party-cookie policy vs. the automated click not registering as a browser-trusted gesture.
Whether a real consent popup opened outside the tracked browser tab group where this review's tooling could not see it.
Whether core CRUD/persistence flows (add/complete a task, habit, ritual; save Settings) actually work end-to-end -- not exercised this session.
Mobile/responsive (<768px) rendering -- not verified this session due to a viewport-resize tooling failure.

limitations: No real Google OAuth credentials were entered; whether the flow succeeds given a completed human consent screen remains genuinely untested.
Browser-automation tooling is scoped to a tracked Chrome tab group and cannot see popups/windows opened outside it at the OS level.
Manual accessibility testing has never been performed on this app in any session.
Core data-entry/persistence flows were not exercised; only empty-state rendering and navigation were tested.

follow_up.item: Have Kieran manually click Connect Google Account with real credentials via a genuine click, while a full-desktop (not tab-scoped) recording runs, to see if a consent popup appears at all.
Verify in Google Cloud Console that Authorized JavaScript origins for the OAuth Client ID exactly match https://okhp3.github.io.
Add a client-side timeout/circuit-breaker to useGoogleAuth.requestToken() so a non-responsive GIS callback surfaces the existing error UI instead of hanging forever.
Fix ThemeContext's default (or update the docs) so first-visit theme matches documented intent.
Inspect the FilterBar/chip component to align Calendar/Rituals/Habits styling with Someday's correctly-styled chips.
Exercise core CRUD flows with console/network monitoring armed and confirm localStorage persistence across reload.
follow_up.expiry_trigger: before certifying acceptance criterion 4 as fully passing
